data.title: 黍 · 起晚了也给你留着早饭
data.description: 家中厨房里，黍穿麦黄围裙与青绿棉裙，端着还温热的粥碗走向你。她微笑示意你坐下，桌上小菜和另一副碗筷都已摆好；灶上的锅盖半开，柔和晨光照在金色手部与围裙口袋上。
data.action: 稳稳端着粥碗走向镜头，示意你入座
data.mood: 熟悉踏实的照顾与包容
data.promptProse: Shu carries a warm bowl of porridge toward the viewer in the home kitchen, smiling to invite them to sit. Her sage cotton dress and wheat-yellow apron face the eye-level cowboy camera. Side dishes and a second set of bowl and chopsticks wait on the table; the stove pot behind has its lid ajar. Morning window light brightens her golden hands and apron pocket, with gentle pot shadows.
